description: Abstract class for processing calculated fields in Thingsboard, handling argument fetching, data retrieval, and saving telemetry or attributes.

classes.name: AbstractCalculatedFieldProcessingService
classes.description: Abstract class providing core logic for processing calculated fields, including argument fetching, data retrieval, and telemetry/attribute saving.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the executor service for callback handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the executor service.

methods.name: fetchArguments
methods.description: Fetches arguments for a calculated field based on its type.

methods.name: resolveEntityId
methods.description: Resolves the entity ID for an argument, considering references and ownership.

methods.name: resolveArgumentFutures
methods.description: Resolves multiple argument futures into actual argument entries.

methods.name: resolveArgumentValue
methods.description: Gets the value from a future, handling exceptions.

methods.name: fetchPropagationCalculatedFieldArgument
methods.description: Fetches propagation argument for propagation type calculated fields.

methods.name: fetchGeofencingCalculatedFieldArguments
methods.description: Fetches geofencing-related arguments, possibly dynamically.

methods.name: fetchRelatedEntitiesAggArguments
methods.description: Fetches arguments for related entities aggregation.

methods.name: fetchEntityAggArguments
methods.description: Fetches arguments for entity aggregation.

methods.name: resolveRelatedEntities
methods.description: Resolves related entities via relation service.

methods.name: resolveGeofencingEntityIds
methods.description: Resolves geofencing entity IDs based on arguments.

methods.name: fromDynamicSource
methods.description: Resolves entity IDs from dynamic sources like owner or relation path.

methods.name: resolveOwnerArgument
methods.description: Resolves owner entity ID.

methods.name: fetchGeofencingArgumentValue
methods.description: Fetches geofencing argument value for entities.

methods.name: fetchGeofencingEntityIdToKvEntriesFutures
methods.description: Fetches attribute key-value entries for geofencing entities.

methods.name: fetchRelatedEntitiesArgumentEntry
methods.description: Fetches argument entries for related entities.

methods.name: fetchArgumentValue
methods.description: Fetches argument value based on argument type.

methods.name: fetchMetricDuringInterval
methods.description: Fetches metric data during a specified interval.

methods.name: fetchTimeSeries
methods.description: Fetches timeseries data for an argument.

methods.name: fetchTsRolling
methods.description: Fetches rolling timeseries data.

methods.name: fetchAttribute
methods.description: Fetches attribute value for an entity.

methods.name: fetchTsLatest
methods.description: Fetches latest timeseries value.

methods.name: fetchTimeSeriesInternal
methods.description: Internal method to fetch timeseries data and transform it.

methods.name: buildTsRollingQuery
methods.description: Builds a query for rolling timeseries data.

methods.name: handlePropagationResults
methods.description: Handles propagation calculation results and invokes handlers.

methods.name: sendMsgToRuleEngine
methods.description: Sends a message to the rule engine.

methods.name: saveTelemetryResult
methods.description: Saves calculated field result as attributes or timeseries.

methods.name: saveAttributes
methods.description: Saves attributes based on output strategy.

methods.name: saveAttributesInternal
methods.description: Internal method to save attributes and notify.

methods.name: saveTimeSeries
methods.description: Saves timeseries data based on output strategy.

methods.name: saveTimeSeriesInternal
methods.description: Internal method to save timeseries data.

methods.name: sendAttributesUpdatedMsg
methods.description: Sends attributes updated message to rule engine.
